contacts_desc: Direct channels to communicate with the VIBICO team.
what_desc: Everything you need to plan your bike trip through Colombia and Latin America.

what_cards.title: Detailed Routes
what_cards.text: Interactive maps with elevation profiles, campsites, distances and points of interest. Find the ideal route for your level and bike type.

what_cards.title: Travel Tips
what_cards.text: Practical guides on essential gear, packing techniques, road nutrition, road safety, travel insurance, and climate recommendations for cycling in Colombia.

what_cards.title: Emergency Numbers
what_cards.text: Complete directory of key contacts: highway police, ambulances, firefighters, civil defense, traveler assistance hotlines organized by region.

what_cards.title: Traveler Information
what_cards.text: Everything about border crossings, immigration requirements, visa extensions, pet entry, mandatory vaccines, and documentation needed to travel between countries.

what_cards.title: Traveler Experiences
what_cards.text: Real stories, travel logs, and recommendations from cyclotourists who have already ridden these routes. Learn from their successes and mistakes.

what_cards.title: Sustainable Mobility
what_cards.text: We promote the use of bicycles as a means of transport and responsible tourism.

social_desc: Follow us on our networks and be part of the community.
support_desc: Our services are **free**, but keeping the platform active has technological costs. Your **voluntary contribution** helps us continue this work and develop a **mobile app for bike travelers**.
important_items: We are not responsible for losses, damages, or injuries during trips or stays.
